objective: Lucy-den holds a current checkout of strategy-factory, its health check passes, and the next Capital Engine work order is identified without any model reasoning.
bottleneck: LucyOS has no local view of the strategy-factory repo, so the money path cannot be evidenced from the phone.
success: aion money-path strategy-factory shows s1 as NEXT with the owner's one action, and the evidence directory exists.

steps.title: Clone or update the strategy-factory checkout under AION_HOME
steps.why: all later DET steps read files from it
steps.exec_command: sh -c 'D="$AION_HOME/PROJECTS/strategy-factory/repo"; if [ -d "$D/.git" ]; then git -C "$D" pull --ff-only; else git clone --depth 50 https://github.com/hetlife/strategy-factory "$D"; fi'

steps.title: Run the repo's own deterministic health check
steps.why: C9: never trust a repo state that its own health check rejects

steps.title: Copy evidence packets into the LucyOS project folder
steps.exec_command: sh -c 'S="$AION_HOME/PROJECTS/strategy-factory/repo/.autonomous/capital_engine/EVIDENCE"; mkdir -p PROJECTS/strategy-factory/evidence; [ -d "$S" ] && cp -n "$S"/*.md PROJECTS/strategy-factory/evidence/ 2>/dev/null; true'
steps.success_criteria: evidence directory exists; any packets present are copied (CE-5-02 makes this nightly and secret-scanned)
